svg.text: A plain chatbot forgets you when the tab closes. Hermes can carry facts from one session to the next.

g.text: A compact profile of your preferences:
how you like answers, tools you use,
how much gets loaded into every
prompt, so memory never floods context.

Memory is what makes an agent feel like an assistant instead of a stranger: but anything it remembers goes into every prompt.
